description: Use this when a visitor asks how a ride's posted wait moved over the last week. Resolve the ride ID first. A row appears only when the wait or status changed, so a wait holds until the next row.

days.description: Park-local days back including today, 1 to 7. Defaults to 7.

ride_id.description: Ride ID from parky_find_experience or parky_list_park_rides (for example magic-kingdom_seven-dwarfs-mine-train), or a ride name or slug when it is unique.

name: parky_get_ride_history
title: Get a ride's wait history
